validation: Every advertised hash was recomputed from its serialized 80-byte header. The combined chain was checked from genesis through the captured tip for height continuity, previous-hash linkage, proof of work, constant intra-period bits, and Bitcoin retarget transitions.
trust_boundary: Header consensus checks establish an internally valid linked proof-of-work chain. The captured tip was independently compared with Blockstream; selected record blocks were cross-checked separately.
